description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Location Plan and Fire Safety Strategy, Proposed Floor Plans and Elevations received 28/02/2023, Unnumbered Floor Plan received 30/03/2023, Cladding details received 19/06/2023].

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at 42 Woodland Gardens, TW7 6LL and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), [no additional windows shall be inserted in any part of the development] [and] [no additional dormer windows] shall be constructed.
